training.scope: rank-32 linear adapters in pretrained SANA self attention and cross attention; pretrained output projection also trainable
training.caption: constant all-zero single-token embedding; no text encoder or task information
training.conditioning: clean answer-free VAE context outside bottom seven latent rows, identically clamped in train and sampling
training.target: two-digit raster subtotal a+b+carry with all 200 local cases trained
training.selection: development local-column accuracy only; independent program tests after final checkpoint

evaluation.runtime: fixed right-to-left schedule; only raw generated carry crop passed to next column; classify after all stages
evaluation.claim_boundary: pretrained image diffusion adaptation and raster-mediated composition of fully supervised elementary facts; no claim of unseen local-fact induction or pretraining benefit without a scratch comparison
evaluation.program_correctness: final sum, valid images at every stage, and every generated subtotal independently correct after generation finishes
